title: Load Tauri config even when API key is empty
detail:
Load Tauri config even when API key is empty

This branch only accepts `get_config` results when `tauriConfig.elevenlabs_api_key` is truthy, so valid app-data settings (for example `output_dir`, preferences, or Drive metadata) are discarded whenever the key is blank or intentionally cleared. In that case startup falls through to static/localStorage instead of using the persisted Tauri config, which regresses config durability compared to previous behavior where app-data config was always loaded.

title: Accept static bridge files without an API key
detail:
Accept static bridge files without an API key

The static fallback now requires `data.elevenlabs_api_key`, but `sync_to_static` intentionally writes `_config.json` with an empty API key (`"elevenlabs_api_key": ""`) to avoid exposing secrets. As a result, browser/Tauri-fallback loading will skip the synced static file and lose non-sensitive bridged settings (voices/preferences/output dir) that were previously imported from `static/_config.json`.
